## RE:volution Mod v1.3.5

### Added

- Circular Location definitions with center/radius gameplay areas shared across Realm geometry.
- One-slot-per-mob Mob Spawn definitions, allowing many physical spawn slots to reuse one mob definition and stat set.
- Independent spawn and movement switches: `FIXED_POINT` / `RANDOM_AREA` and `STATIONARY` / `ROAMING`.
- Shared player-Realm spawn geometry for Realm 1/2/3 and explicit Realm 0-only spawn scope.
- Location lookup, circular-boundary helpers, random X/Z placement and fixed-spawn Realm resolution.
- Standalone regression coverage for the complete v1.3.5 foundation contract.

### Fixed

- No runtime bug fixes are included in this foundation-only change.

### Other

- Random-area surface Y resolution is deferred to runtime world logic.
- Entity spawning, respawn loops, roaming AI, boundary steering, out-of-bounds reset, rewards, progression and scaling are intentionally outside this foundation.
- Existing Realm startup synchronization and MongoDB schemas are unchanged.

### Download

The project remains on the existing development version metadata while this branch is under review; these notes do not publish a release.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v1.3.4...feature/v1.3.5-location-mob-position
